CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `onboarding_surveys` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `userId` int,
  `companyId` int,
  `thumbs` enum('up','down') NOT NULL,
  `questions` json,
  `responses` json,
  `briefingFrequency` varchar(32),
  `email` varchar(320),
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now())
);
